# Guide Production Studio

A Muse agent skill that builds source-grounded practical guides: manuals, how-to pages, prompt guides, reference libraries. It turns your supplied sources into a complete guide a reader can actually follow — with source lineage, reader-first structure, real evidence and examples, and an honest independent review before anything scales or publishes. It never invents examples or results; gaps are labeled, not hidden.
